label: Rowe's WhollyGood satisfies the outcome-minimizing standard (WHOLLY_GOOD_1)
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Every Rowe-wholly-good being, for each occurring event it can prevent, is such that preventing it would not be strictly better than permitting it.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Select a sense of WhollyGood for the case's GOD_4 bearer on a carrier shared with Rowe's signature (the planned bridge of STMT-ROWE-NO-THEISTIC-BEING). Under WHOLLY_GOOD_1 with the outcome bridge, STMT-ROWE-PERMISSION-CONSTRAINT follows; under WHOLLY_GOOD_2 only the constraint-qualified permission condition follows, so Rowe's core would additionally need that some constraint-free way of preventing the suffering exists; under WHOLLY_GOOD_3 neither follows.
connection_plan.blocker: No warranted identification of Rowe's WhollyGood with any of the three senses for the case bearer exists. The outcome bridge is open (several individually lesser costs may jointly outweigh a suffering), divine permission versus intention is owned by issue #1456, and the bearer bridge by issue #1735.
